title: Portfolio
subtitle: Programs and projects you are authorized to see. Each status dimension is tracked separately.
empty: No projects are visible to you yet.
emptyHint: Projects appear here once you are granted a role on them.
noDimensions: This template defines no separate status dimensions.
notVisible: Not visible with your current access
laterTitle: Portfolio health, value and upcoming obligations
laterBody: Health roll-ups, value/budget and upcoming obligations depend on the planning (P2) and finance (P4) modules.

wizard.title: Create project
wizard.subtitle: Create a project from a published template. Template content starts as Draft/Unverified until owners confirm it.
wizard.templateHint: Choose the published template version to start from.
wizard.codeHint: Upper-case letters, digits and dashes (2–31 characters), e.g. DC-2027.
wizard.classificationHint: Controls who can see the project: users need at least this clearance.
wizard.plannedStartHint: Planned date only — actual dates are recorded later with evidence.

newco.title: NewCo (target legal entity)
newco.name: NewCo name
newco.unverifiedNote: The status is recorded as reported and stays unverified until incorporation evidence is uploaded and verified. It does not change the transfer or operational readiness dimensions.

errors.code: Use 2–31 upper-case letters, digits or dashes, starting with a letter or digit.
errors.incomplete: Some required information is missing. Go back to complete it.

effects.create: Project {code} is created from “{template}” with {gates} gates, {workstreams} workstreams and {activities} activities.
effects.draft: Template-generated tasks, milestones and deliverables start as Draft and must be confirmed by the project manager.
effects.pm: {user} is granted the project manager role.
effects.newco: The NewCo is recorded with the reported status and verification “{verification}”; it is not treated as verified until incorporation evidence is verified.
